note: Generated by clients/ua-rs tests/groups.rs (feature signers: BIP-327 MuSig2 over k256 + the bn254 port, ZF frost-core 3.0.0 / frost-secp256k1 3.0.0 + the FROST(bn254, keccak256) ciphersuite); never edit by hand. Schema: SCHEMA in the UA-2c plan (groups[] rows, negatives with entry/error, bip327, rfc9591E5, zfDkg, tFrost). The secp256k1 rows are re-verified by clientkeys test/ua-groups.test.js (noble); musig2-bn254 (our BIP-327 port) and FROST(bn254, keccak256) have no independent second implementation: clients/ua-rs agreeing on them is self-consistency only (accounts.md §1.16).

frost-secp256k1.H2: expand_message_xmd SHA-256, DST contextString ‖ "chal", 48 bytes mod N, over R(33) ‖ Y(33) ‖ msg
frost-secp256k1.HDKG: expand_message_xmd SHA-256, DST contextString ‖ "dkg", 48 bytes mod N, over id(32, big-endian) ‖ C_i0(33) ‖ R_i(33)

frost-bn254.H2: scaas Schnorr challenge over R(64) ‖ Y(64) ‖ msg
frost-bn254.HDKG: keccak256(cs ‖ "dkg" ‖ m ‖ 0x00) ‖ keccak256(cs ‖ "dkg" ‖ m ‖ 0x01) mod r, m = id(32, big-endian) ‖ C_i0(64) ‖ R_i(64)

musig2-bn254.L: tagged("KeyAgg list", P_1 ‖ … ‖ P_n), 32 bytes, P_i 64 bytes
musig2-bn254.a_i: tagged("KeyAgg coefficient", L ‖ P_i ‖ 0x00) ‖ tagged(… ‖ 0x01) mod r; 1 for the second distinct key
musig2-bn254.b: widened tagged("MuSig/noncecoef", aggnonce(128) ‖ Q(64) ‖ msg) mod r
musig2-bn254.challenge: scaas Schnorr over R(64) ‖ Q(64) ‖ msg
